ABOUT.title: About Me
ABOUT.p1: I am a front-end developer passionate about technology and design. With 4 years of experience, I specialize in turning ideas into intuitive, high-performance user interfaces.

ABOUT.p3: I'm always learning, exploring new tools, and seeking challenges that help me grow professionally.
